title: Hallway · Red carpet
instruction: Turn left and go straight. Walk until you reach the red carpet and stop.

title: Campus · Recliner
instruction: Go straight. On the left, there is a brown recliner. Walk over there and stop.

title: Office · Sofa

title: Office · Water dispenser
instruction: Turn right and go straight. There is a black storage rack against the wall. Walk up to the water dispenser beside the rack and stop.

title: Bedroom to staircase
instruction: Leave the bedroom and walk straight.  When you get to the glass wine room, turn left and walk through the doorway past it.  Go down the hallway to the right and turn left at the stairs.  Go up the first step and then stop.

title: Across the bedroom
instruction: Walk forward and turn right, exiting the room. Continue forward and turn right, walking past the mirror and side table. Enter the bedroom and turn left. Turn left again and wait inside the doorway.
